fields.name: Ability Score Increase
fields.desc: Your Dexterity score increases by 2.

fields.name: Age
fields.desc: Catfolk mature at the same rate as humans and can live just past a century.

fields.name: Alignment
fields.desc: Catfolk tend toward two extremes. Some are free-spirited and chaotic, letting impulse and fancy guide their decisions. Others are devoted to duty and personal honor.

fields.name: Size
fields.desc: Catfolk have a similar stature to humans but are generally leaner and more muscular. Your size is Medium.

fields.name: Speed
fields.desc: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

fields.name: Darkvision
fields.desc: You have a cat's keen senses, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

fields.name: Cat's Claws
fields.desc: You have claws that you can use as natural weapons to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal slashing damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

fields.name: Hunter's Senses
fields.desc: You have proficiency in the Perception and Stealth skills.

fields.name: Ability Score Increase
fields.desc: Your Charisma score increases by 1.

fields.name: Goddess's Blessing
fields.desc: The gift of the goddess allows you to communicate in a limited manner with non-humanoid feline beasts. They can understand the meaning of your words, though you have no special ability to understand them in turn. You have advantage on all Charisma checks you make to influence them.

fields.name: Climber
fields.desc: Your reflexes and claws allow you to scale vertical surfaces with a burst of speed. When you move at least 10 feet horizontally first, you can use the rest of your movement to traverse vertical surfaces.

fields.name: Stalker's Reflex
fields.desc: You have advantage on Dexterity checks for initiative.

fields.name: Ability Score Increase
fields.desc: Your Strength score increases by 1.

fields.name: Form of the Lion
fields.desc: As an action, you can assume a leonine form. While in this form, your statistics remain the same, except you move as a quadruped instead of a biped, you can't speak or cast spells, and your speed increases by 10 feet. Additionally, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell, and you gain a bite attack that deals 1d6 + Strength modifier piercing damage. You can revert to your normal form as an action.

fields.name: Ability Score Increase
fields.desc: Your Strength score increases by 2.

fields.name: Age
fields.desc: Gnolls reach adulthood at age 12, and they live short and brutal lives. The rare examples that die of old age experience only around 70 summers.

fields.name: Alignment
fields.desc: As a product of a culture that values laziness, selfishness, and dominance, most gnolls are evil. An unpredictable existence usually leads to a chaotic view of the world.

fields.name: Size
fields.desc: Gnoll females are taller and more powerfully built than their male counterparts. The former range from 7 to 8 feet and usually weigh more than 250 pounds. Your size is Medium.

fields.name: Speed
fields.desc: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

fields.name: Darkvision
fields.desc: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You cannot discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

fields.name: Scent
fields.desc: You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

fields.name: Bully
fields.desc: You have disadvantage on saving throws against being frightened. However, whenever you make a Charisma (Intimidation) check involving obviously smaller or weaker targets, you are considered proficient in the Intimidation skill and add double your proficiency bonus to the check.

fields.name: Live to Fight Another Day
fields.desc: When you take the Disengage action, your base walking speed increases by 10 feet until the end of your turn.

fields.name: Gnoll Weapon Training
fields.desc: You have proficiency with the spear, shortbow, longbow, light crossbow, and heavy crossbow.

fields.name: Ability Score Increase
fields.desc: Your Constitution score increases by 1.

fields.name: Obsequious
fields.desc: Whenever you make a Charisma (Persuasion) check for dealing with obviously bigger or more powerful targets, you are considered proficient in the Persuasion skill and add double your proficiency bonus to the check.

fields.name: Ability Score Increase
fields.desc: Your Wisdom score increases by 1.

fields.name: Scavenge
fields.desc: Whenever you make a Wisdom (Survival) check for gathering food or locating water, you are considered proficient in the Survival skill and add double your proficiency bonus to the check.

fields.name: Ability Score Increase
fields.desc: Your Charisma score increases by 1.

fields.name: Heat Tolerance
fields.desc: You have resistance to fire damage. You can go three times as long without water as most other humanoids.

fields.name: Ability Score Increase
fields.desc: Your Dexterity score increases by 1.

fields.name: Among the Dead
fields.desc: You have resistance to necrotic damage.

fields.name: Curse Defiance
fields.desc: You have advantage on saving throws against curses.

fields.name: Ability Score Increase
fields.desc: Your Constitution score increases by 2.

fields.name: Age
fields.desc: Jinnborn reach maturity at age 16 and can live to be over 150.

fields.name: Alignment
fields.desc: There is no single alignment among the jinnborn that typifies them all.

fields.name: Size
fields.desc: Jinnborn tend to be slightly shorter than humans, with stout, well-muscled builds. Your size is Medium.

fields.name: Speed
fields.desc: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

fields.name: Darkvision
fields.desc: Thanks to your jinn blood, you can see in dim light within 60 feet as though it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

fields.name: Desert Dependent
fields.desc: At least once each year, you must spend 8 hours meditating in a desert or other warm, arid environment to reaffirm your siraati and your connection to your tribe's patron jinn. If you refuse or are unable to meditate in this way, you lose sight of your siraati and become vulnerable to a type of damage opposed to your siraati.

fields.name: Negotiator
fields.desc: You have proficiency in the Persuasion skill.

fields.name: Siraati
fields.desc: All jinnborn have an affinity for mystic paths, depending on the jinn patron of their tribe. Choose one of the following siraati: air, earth, fire, or water.

fields.name: Ability Score Increase
fields.desc: Your Wisdom score increases by 1.

fields.name: Favor of the Jinn
fields.desc: You can call upon your jinn patron to gain advantage on a saving throw or ability check, or to impose disadvantage on an attack roll against you. You can use this ability a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

fields.name: Walker
fields.desc: You have advantage on saving throws against being stunned and the effects of extreme environments, and on ability checks made to navigate the wilderness and avoid losing your way.

fields.name: Ability Score Increase
fields.desc: Your Strength score increases by 1.

fields.name: Elemental Strike
fields.desc: Once on your turn when you hit with a melee attack, you can deal an additional 1d6 damage. The damage type corresponds to your siraati (lightning for air, acid for earth, fire for fire, cold for water). You can use this ability a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1).

fields.name: Protection of the Jinn
fields.desc: You have resistance against a type of damage that corresponds to your siraati (lightning for air, acid for earth, fire for fire, cold for water).

fields.name: Ability Score Increase
fields.desc: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

fields.name: Age
fields.desc: Minotaurs mature at roughly the same rate as humans but mature 3 years earlier. Childhood ends around the age of 10 and adulthood is celebrated at 15.

fields.name: Alignment
fields.desc: Minotaurs possess a wide range of alignments. Mixing a love for personal freedom and respect for history and tradition, the majority of minotaurs fall into neutral alignments.

fields.name: Size
fields.desc: Adult males can reach a height of 6½ to 7 feet, with females averaging 3 inches shorter. Your size is Medium.

fields.name: Speed
fields.desc: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

fields.name: Darkvision
fields.desc: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You cannot discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

fields.name: Natural Attacks
fields.desc: You have proficiency with your horns, which deal 1d6 piercing damage.

fields.name: Charge
fields.desc: If you move at least 10 feet toward a target and hit it with a horn attack in the same turn, you deal an extra 1d6 piercing damage and you can shove the target as a bonus action. You can apply this extra damage once per turn.

fields.name: Labyrinth Sense
fields.desc: You can retrace without error any path you have previously taken, with no ability check.

fields.name: Ability Score Increase
fields.desc: One of your physical ability scores (Strength, Dexterity, Constitution) increases by 2, and one of your mental ability scores (Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma) increases by 2. You also take a –2 penalty to any one ability score.

fields.name: Age
fields.desc: Tosculi reach maturity at around 13 years but have shorter lifespans than most races with few living longer than 40 years.

fields.name: Alignment
fields.desc: The tension between tosculi and other humanoids often makes it difficult for the Hiveless to develop any true sense of altruism toward others, and many are neutral in alignment.

fields.name: Size
fields.desc: Hiveless tosculi are no more than 4 feet tall and typically weigh less than a humanoid of the same size. Your size is Small.

fields.name: Speed
fields.desc: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

fields.name: Natural Armor
fields.desc: Your Armor Class cannot be less than 11 + your Dexterity modifier no matter what armor you are wearing.

fields.name: Natural Attacks
fields.desc: You have proficiency with your claws, which deal 1d4 slashing damage.

fields.name: Gliding Wings
fields.desc: You take no damage from falls. You gain a fly speed of 40 feet but cannot hover. At the end of any round you fly, you must have descended at least one-quarter the distance you traveled or you fall.

fields.name: Stalker
fields.desc: You have proficiency in the Perception skill and Stealth skill.

fields.name: Ability Score Increase
fields.desc: Your Dexterity score increases by 2 and your Charisma score increases by 1.

fields.name: Age
fields.desc: Heru reach adulthood at 10 years old and can live to be 110.

fields.name: Alignment
fields.desc: Heru tend toward chaos thanks to their capriciousness and insatiable curiosity. Greed overwhelms some heru, drawing them toward evil.

fields.name: Size
fields.desc: Heru are slighter and shorter than humans. They range from 4 feet to just shy of 6 feet tall. Your size is Medium.

fields.name: Speed
fields.desc: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

fields.name: Sudden Attack
fields.desc: You have advantage on attack rolls against a surprised creature.

fields.name: Mimicry
fields.desc: Heru can mimic any sound they've heard. Make a Charisma (Deception) check against the passive Wisdom (Insight) of any listeners. Success indicates they believe the sound you created was real.

fields.name: Trickster
fields.desc: You have proficiency in the Deception and Stealth skills.

fields.name: Ability Score Increase
fields.desc: Your Constitution score increases by 2.

fields.name: Age
fields.desc: Lizardfolk reach maturity around age 10 and rarely live longer than 60 years.

fields.name: Alignment
fields.desc: Most lizardfolk are neutral, as their emotional reactions tend to be different than warm-blooded creatures.

fields.name: Size
fields.desc: Lizardfolk are bulkier than humans, and their colorful frills make them seem even larger. Your size is Medium.

fields.name: Speed
fields.desc: Your base walking speed is 30 feet and you have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

fields.name: Natural Weapons
fields.desc: Your fanged maw and sharp claws are natural weapons which you can use to make unarmed strikes. Your bite deals 1d4 + your Strength modifier piercing damage, and your claws deal 1d4 + Strength modifier slashing damage.

fields.name: Hold Breath
fields.desc: You can hold your breath for up to 15 minutes at a time.

fields.name: Natural Armor
fields.desc: Your skin is covered with strong scales. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. You can use your natural armor to determine your AC if the armor you wear would leave you with a lower AC.

fields.name: Hunter's Knack
fields.desc: You gain proficiency with two of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Nature, Perception, Stealth, and Survival.

fields.name: Languages
fields.desc: You can read, write and speak Southern Trade Tongue and Draconic.

fields.name: Ability Score Increase
fields.desc: Your Wisdom score increases by 1.

fields.name: Swift Swimmers
fields.desc: Your swimming speed is 40 feet.

fields.name: Swamp Stealth
fields.desc: You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in swamp or marsh terrain.

fields.name: Ability Score Increase
fields.desc: Your Dexterity score increases by 1.

fields.name: Gift of Grace
fields.desc: You have advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.

fields.name: Gift of Vigor
fields.desc: Your maximum hit points increase by 1, and an additional 1 each time you gain a level.

fields.name: Ability Score Increase
fields.desc: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.

fields.name: Age
fields.desc: Ramag reach maturity at 15 years and can live to 90.

fields.name: Size
fields.desc: Despite their overlong limbs, ramag stand between 5 and 6 feet tall. Your size is Medium.

fields.name: Alignment
fields.desc: Ramag tend toward lawfulness, since their survival depends on adhering to their laws and customs.

fields.name: Speed
fields.desc: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

fields.name: Arcane Heritage
fields.desc: You can ignore class requirements when attuning to a magic item.

fields.name: Mystical Understanding
fields.desc: You have proficiency in the Arcana skill.

fields.name: Spell Damping
fields.desc: You have advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws against spells.

fields.name: Languages
fields.desc: You can speak, read, and write Common and Giant.

fields.name: Ability Score Increase
fields.desc: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and you choose one of the following to increase by 1: Strength, Intelligence, or Wisdom.

fields.name: Age
fields.desc: Subek age at roughly the same rate as humans but mature faster, reaching adulthood around the age of 10. They can live up to 300 years.

fields.name: Alignment
fields.desc: Subek possess a wide range of alignment. The ties to the natural pattern of their river homes tend to push many subek toward lawful or neutral alignments.

fields.name: Size
fields.desc: Adult males can reach a height of 8½ feet with females averaging 5 inches shorter. Your size is Medium.

fields.name: Speed
fields.desc: Your base walking speed is 30 feet and your swim speed is 30 feet.

fields.name: Darkvision
fields.desc: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You cannot discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

fields.name: Natural Weapons
fields.desc: Your powerful bite and sharp claws are natural weapons that you can use to make unarmed strikes. Your bite deals 1d8 + your Strength modifier piercing damage and your claws deal 1d6 + Strength modifier slashing damage.

fields.name: Hold Breath
fields.desc: Accustomed to your watery home, you can hold your breath for up to 15 minutes.

fields.name: Flood Fever
fields.desc: Choose three consecutive months out of the year to reflect the flood season of your river birthplace. During this time, you lose the benefits of your Scholars trait. When a creature deals damage to you, every attack you make and harmful spell you cast must include that creature as a target. Once per turn when you hit your target with an attack, you deal an additional 1d6 damage.

fields.name: Scholars
fields.desc: When it is not flood season, you have advantage on Intelligence (History) and Intelligence (Investigation) checks.

fields.name: Languages
fields.desc: You can speak, read, and write Southern Trade Tongue as well as a second language of your choice.

fields.name: Ability Score Increase
fields.desc: Your Constitution score increases by 2.

fields.name: Age
fields.desc: Trollkin reach maturity by the age of 15 and live up to 60 years.

fields.name: Alignment
fields.desc: Trollkin tend toward chaotic alignments. Their fey blood makes them crave freedom and reject law, while their monstrous origins often draw them toward evil.

fields.name: Size
fields.desc: Trollkin are tall and lanky, ranging from 6 to 7 feet tall. Your size is Medium.

fields.name: Speed
fields.desc: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

fields.name: Darkvision
fields.desc: Thanks to your fey ancestry, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

fields.name: Natural Weapons
fields.desc: You have fangs that you can use as natural weapons to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal piercing damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength modifier.

fields.name: Regeneration
fields.desc: You regain hit points equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1) at the start of your turn if you have at least 1 hit point. This regeneration doesn't function if you took acid or fire damage since the start of your last turn.

fields.name: Thick Hide
fields.desc: Your tough skin provides some protection. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC equals 12 + your Dexterity modifier.

fields.name: Languages
fields.desc: You can speak, read, and write Southern Trade Tongue and Giant.

fields.name: Ability Score Increase
fields.desc: Your Wisdom score increases by 1.

fields.name: Heat Adapted
fields.desc: You have resistance to fire damage and are naturally adapted to hot climates.

fields.name: Desert Knowledge
fields.desc: You have proficiency in the Survival skill.
